Let's talk

DEVELOPER ADVOCATE • COMMUNITY BUILDER • TECHNICAL EDUCATOR

I turn curious developers into builders.

I love the moment a developer goes from “what is this?” to “I just shipped it.” I sit between the teams who build developer tools and the developers who use them, turning complex products into workshops, demos and docs, and developer feedback into product fixes.

  • 12K+developers engaged
  • 1,000+builders mentored
  • 150+workshops & university sessions
  • 60+hackathons partnered
  • 15+college blockchain clubs set up
  • 10+hackathons judged

Part engineer, part community builder.

I'm Simarpreet, Partnership & Ecosystem Lead at SOULVERSE, where we are building the trust layer that connects identity, credentials, compliance and payments.

Before that, I spent 2.5 years leading Developer Relations at Tezos India and evangelising Etherlink, an EVM rollup on Tezos. I ran workshops across India and Southeast Asia, scaled the TezAsia hackathon from 1,500 to 13,000+ participants, and co-created a credit-based blockchain course with the University of the Philippines.

Alongside that, I run Web3Panjab, a grassroots community onboarding North India to Web3, and a YouTube series on building with Sui from a Solidity developer's perspective. I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from GTBIT, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (2018–2022).

What I bring to any dev team.

Stack-agnostic skills, proven on real developer programs. The tools change; the job of getting developers from first contact to shipped does not.

  • Developer onboarding: −40% onboarding questions

    Starter kits, CLI walkthroughs and explainer videos cut repeat onboarding questions on Discord by 40%.

  • Technical education: 150+ workshops & sessions

    Mentored 1,000+ builders through structured workshops and live POC demos, and co-created a credit-backed course for 72 students at the University of the Philippines.

  • Developer programs: 75% graduation rate

    Designed a two-cohort builder camp; 60+ developers stayed on as long-term contributors.

  • Product feedback loop: +24% wallet activation

    Worked with wallet, explorer and protocol teams to turn developer feedback into SDK fixes, including a 24% activation lift for Naan Wallet.

  • Events & hackathons: 1.5K → 13K+ hackathon participants

    Scaled a flagship hackathon nearly 9×, and ran 40+ in-person community events across India on a single day.

  • Content & storytelling: 35+ articles & videos

    Tutorials, talks and explainers on Medium, dev.to and YouTube, written for beginners and experienced developers alike.

Projects

  • SuiSips

    Next.js · Client build. A production SIP tracker and community platform for the Sui ecosystem: proposals synced from GitHub, discussions, articles, videos and a curated tweet wall. Built with Next.js, React Markdown and Tailwind CSS.

  • Miden SDK Simulator

    React · Miden SDK. An interactive demo of anonymous, privacy-preserving voting on Miden's ZK rollup SDK. Scoped, built and shipped with no prior Miden experience, to show how any new SDK becomes learnable through a working demo.

  • Etherlink Project Showcase

    Etherlink · GitHub. A showcase repo spotlighting dApps built on Tezos and Etherlink after hackathons, alongside demo apps for workshop attendees.

  • Gitfund

    Web3 · OSS. Auto-pays open-source contributors for merged PRs using programmable smart-contract logic.

  • JSON API Visualizer

    Next.js · Live tool. Fetch any public REST API and explore the response as an interactive graph and tree. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and v0.

  • OverWatch TS

    Open source. Built the initial example template for overwatch-ts, a lightweight state-management library for Next.js.

  • Virtual Tweet Gallery

    Community tool. The W3EventGallery bot collects event tweets into a shared gallery of memories.

  • German → English Translator

    ML. A Seq2Seq-with-attention tutorial implementation for German-to-English translation.

  • Face Detection & Recognition

    OpenCV. Haar-cascade face and eye detection that can also save and recognise faces by name.
